blind_judge.summary: Both agents respect the no-chasing preference, respond appropriately to the Saturday viewing request, and avoid claiming a confirmed booking. B wins narrowly because it explicitly identifies the need for a team check and handles the booking uncertainty more transparently. A is also careful not to book without consent, but its promise to check and report slots is less clear about the limits of its ability to confirm them.
